findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "check_tracking" references sensitive artifacts (cookie). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_business_details, check_tracking, check_structured_data, preview_landing_page · Private data: get_business_details, full_site_report · Public sink: get_business_details.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_business_details, check_tracking, check_structured_data, preview_landing_page · Private data: get_business_details, full_site_report · Public sink: get_business_details

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
